requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - Deleted columns still display on Reservation List headers on the Print View
requirement.description:
Scenario 1: Deleted columns still display on Reservation List headers

Prerequisites:

- There are some reservations created on the current date(e.g.,2026-06-24).

Steps:

- Admin > Table Management System > Other Settings > Config by Location >

Reservation List's Headers on Current / Calendar View > find your outlet setting, add "Table No." column on your outlet config.

- Go to TMS2.0 operation > Current View, click the print icon on the Reservation List.

- Print Reservation List Dialog, select to show "Table No."

- Click the [Print] button.

- Admin > Table Management System > Other Settings > Config by Location >

Reservation List's Headers on Current / Calendar View > find your outlet setting, delete "Table No." column on your outlet config.

- Logout TMS2.0 operation,Login again > Calender View(Pick the date 2026-06-26), click the print icon on the Reservation List.

Actual result:

The Reservation List still shows the"Table No." column, though  the show column option  is without the "Table No." option

Expect result:

Fields that have been set to be hidden should not be displayed.

Scenario 2: The reservation list order before and after printing is different.

Prerequisites:

- There are some reservations created on a date(e.g.,2026-06-26).

- Admin > Table Management System > Other Settings > Config by Location >

Reservation List's Headers on Current / Calendar View > find your outlet setting, add "Table No." column on your outlet config.

Steps:

- Go to TMS2.0 operation > Calendar View(2026-06-26), click the print icon on the Reservation List.

- Print Reservation List Dialog, select to show "Table No."

- Click the "Table No." column title twice to make the reservation list descend by"Table No."

- Click the [Print] button.

Actual result:

The order of the dialog and the printer view is different.

Step 3 shows the reservation list order

Step 4 shows the reservation list order

Expect result:

The Reservation List sorting before and after printing is consistent.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-66233] TMS2.0 - Deleted columns still display on Reservation List headers on the Print View
Descriptions:
The reservation list order before and after printing is different.
In the print preview page, when there are many columns, they will not automatically shrink.
Deleted columns still display on Reservation List headers
Setup:
Create multiple bookings in a period, where two of the bookings use the same table number. For example, Booking A's table is 120, and Booking B's tables are 120 and 122.
Click the print icon on the Reservation List.
Print Reservation List Dialog, select to show "Table No."
Click the "Table No." column title twice to make the reservation list descend by "Table No."
Click the [Print] button, the Reservation List sorting before and after printing is consistent
Go to Table Management System > Other Settings > Config by Location > Reservation List's Headers on Current / Calendar View > find your outlet setting, delete "Table No." column on your outlet config.
Logout TMS2.0 operation, Login again > Current View, click the print icon on the Reservation List.
The cached data will be cleared, and the default fields will be displayed.
The Reservation Status field will not be removed just because it does not exist in the Current / Calendar View booking list headers
Print Reservation List – select approximately 12 headers.
Click the [Print] button, the print preview will automatically shrink to display more columns.
Reminder: The print data is limited by a threshold based on the paper size, so if many headers are selected, they will not all be displayed in the print preview.
